definitions.capacity_mw: Registered installed capacity (v_kw_tot / 1000). Not generation, not output.
definitions.status: in_operation = listed in the source layer of installations in operation, no end date recorded.
definitions.point: Representative point inside the official perimeter (ETRS89/UTM30N → WGS84). Not a turbine or meter location.
definitions.merra2_cell: The 0.5° × 0.625° MERRA-2 cell containing the point. Width/height in km are approximate (spherical).
definitions.evidence_scope: Province (INE code from the register's municipality code) whose precomputed area-weighted MERRA-2 T2M result is shown.

inclusion_rule: register code, name and registered capacity > 0 kW present; known technology; duplicate polygons consistent; province in ES41 with a precomputed NASA scope; point on the MERRA-2 grid
not_included: Generation (MWh), capacity factors, performance, rankings, suitability scores and forecasts are not in this file and must not be derived from it.
